The [[Keymaster of Murakai]] drops a [[Dungeon Key]] needed to progress in [[Cathedral of Flames]]. It spawns near players on the third level, but if it isn't killed immediately it will move to the point shown on the map. It will drop the key regardless of where it is killed.
